description:
An eye in the top panel that follows your cursor, a mouse indicator that highlights clicks, a pointer trail for pointing at things on the screen, and a cat that runs after the cursor. Made for screen recordings, presentations, screen sharing and large monitors.

EYE
The eye in the top panel always looks at the cursor. Seven shapes: a round eye, an eye with lids, a cat eye, a pair of eyes, a cartoon eye, a lens and a crosshair. Set its size, line thickness, margin and place in the panel.
The eye can also blink, blink on every click, widen its pupil when the cursor comes close, and fall asleep when the mouse is idle.

MOUSE INDICATOR
A shape follows the cursor and changes color on left, middle and right clicks, so viewers can see what you click. Turn it on and off from the menu of the eye.
- 19 shapes
- Adjustable size and opacity
- Separate colors for each mouse button
- The eye can take the color of the indicator while it is on

POINTER TRAIL
An animation follows the mouse, either only while Ctrl is held or all the time. Four animations:
- Water ripples: rings spread out behind the cursor
- Pointer line: a smooth line that fades away, like a laser pointer
- Comet tail: dots that shrink and disappear
- Sparkles: pieces that scatter around the cursor
Shape, size, line thickness, duration and color are adjustable.

CAT
A ginger cat lives on the desktop. It is off by default.
- Runs after the cursor, sits down next to it, grooms itself and falls asleep
- Click it and it swipes a paw, tumbles, rolls over or jumps
- Hold the left button to pick it up by the scruff, carry it and throw it
- Shake the cursor next to it and it runs away, sulks and avoids the cursor for a minute
Size and distance to the cursor are adjustable.

Click the eye to open its menu: switches for the mouse indicator, the pointer trail and the cat, and the settings. Every setting has a short explanation, and one button resets everything to the defaults.

Clicks and Ctrl are detected in application windows too, including on Wayland. The effects also work in remote desktop (RDP) sessions. Translated into German, French, Dutch and Russian.
name: Eye and Mouse Extended
